name: @rembric/monorepo
description: Rembric monorepo root — manages apps/server and apps/plugin workspaces.
author: rembric contributors

scripts.test: pnpm -r run test && pnpm run test:hermes-plugin
scripts.test:hermes-plugin: command -v python3 >/dev/null && python3 -m unittest discover -s apps/plugin/.hermes-plugin/tests -v || echo '[skip] python3 not available; Hermes plugin tests skipped'
scripts.e2e:installer: for f in install.sh apps/plugin/install.sh apps/plugin/.hermes-plugin/install.sh apps/plugin/.hermes-plugin/uninstall.sh apps/plugin/.opencode-plugin/install.sh apps/plugin/.opencode-plugin/uninstall.sh; do sh -n "$f" || exit 1; done && pnpm --filter @rembric/server exec vitest run ../../install.test.ts
